user.title: Dingtian Relay Configuration
user.description: Configure your Dingtian Relay board connection.

tooltip.password: Relay Password (0~9999) used for Dingtian communication.
tooltip.lockout: If enabled, once triggered, the relay cannot be reactivated again for 30 seconds.
tooltip.pulse_time: Defines how long (in ms) the relay remains active after triggering.
